## Source document

Path or URL of the document and the sections involved:

## Requested language or correction

For a translation, state the target language and intended audience. For a correction, quote or describe the inaccurate part without copying unrelated content.

## Factual and license checks

- [ ] Commands, paths, parameter IDs and URLs will remain accurate.
- [ ] The translation will preserve the model, SDK and evidence boundaries.
- [ ] I will retain CC BY 4.0 attribution for a translated or adapted document.
- [ ] I will link to the canonical model license instead of changing its legal wording.

## Suggested patch

Add a short outline, a proposed wording, or a link to a focused pull request. Do not attach private source files or credentials.
